stories.headline: Banco Bradesco Director Alvarez Buys $2.3 Million Shares. Is the Brazilian Bank Now a Buy?
stories.body: Key PointsThe purchase of ~131,000 shares represented a total capital commitment of ~$2.3 million at $17.98 per share.

stories.headline: What climate finance means for portfolios
stories.body: As the U.N. renews its call for $1.3 trillion a year in climate finance, four leaders in climate finance say the biggest question for advisors is where that money goes.

stories.headline: Philadelphia Fed's Anna Paulson says 'modest' rate moves likely ahead to tame inflation
stories.body: The policymaker said she and her colleagues may need to raise interest rates further to bring inflation back to target.
